name: search
description: Discover Cairn operations. Search names/descriptions with query, or select exact names. Summary results are small; request detail="schema" for full input schemas before calling an operation. Use execute with await cairn.<name>(args). No data or credentials are read by discovery.

name: execute
description: Execute a JavaScript async function body against Cairn. Discover operations with search first. Call await cairn.<operation>(args), or await cairn.call(name,args), and return a JSON value. Optional JSON input is available as the input global. Example: const page = await cairn.list_chats({limit:10}); return page.chats.map(c => ({id:c.id,title:c.title})); Intermediate results stay outside model context. Each operation validates arguments and permissions; script calls are sequential and effects are not transactional as a group. Earlier effects remain if a later call fails. Limits: 30 seconds wall time, 2 seconds CPU, 64 MiB JS heap, 64 operation calls, 1 MiB serialized result; no filesystem, network, process, module or environment access. Return the result; console is unavailable.

input.description: Optional JSON data available as the input global. Pass large or untrusted arguments here instead of embedding them in code.
